note: Window agent corrections for -600..-501: Gedrosia gap, Lydian Ionia, Xu kept until 512.

region.text: Iranian Baluchestan and Makran (Gedrosia), the part of Cliopatria's 500 outline in Sistan and Baluchestan that the Pakistan-only Indus event (ledger/13) leaves out

events.note: Gedrosia (Makran, 'from the Indus River to the north-eastern edge of the Strait of Hormuz') 'was conquered by Cyrus the Great or Darius the Great'; the page gives no year. Bridged at 515 with Darius's Indus campaign (ledger/13) so the 519 cells between Kerman and the Indus are not left empty inside the empire until the -500 keyframe snap; Drangiana to the north is already drawn.

correction.text: Cliopatria's 750 shape kept from 584, without the Xu heartland (47 cells), which Xu kept until Wu conquered it in 512

keyframe_overrides.why: 'Reduced to its heartland, Xu was eventually conquered by Wu in 512 BC'; in 584 'Xu was also attacked by Wu forces' but 'Xu found itself under pressure by both of these powerful states' afterwards, so it was not annexed then. The draft gave Xu's heartland to Wu in 584 by rule R2 (wu succeeds xu), 28 years too early.

correction.text: Cliopatria's 550 shape without the Xu heartland, which Wu takes in 512 (ledger/2)

keyframe_overrides.why: Same as wu_-584: Cliopatria's Wu outline covers Xu's heartland from 750 to 480, but Xu was 'conquered by Wu in 512 BC'; the -512 gain event hands the land over.

correction.text: the dossier's Median outline (north-eastern Iran to the Halys, without Afghanistan and Pakistan) without the Urartian kingdom's land, which stays Urartu's until Van falls in 590 (kingdom-of-urartu/ledger/11 then hands it to the Medes)

keyframe_overrides.why: 'The Medes then took over the Urartian capital of Van in 590 BC, effectively ending the sovereignty of Urartu'; Rusa IV ruled '609-590 or 585 BC'. The draft gave 433 Urartian cells to the Medes on 1 Jan -600 by rule R2 (median succeeds urartu), ten years before Urartu ends; the Medes' undated reach to the Halys keeps its unowned part (ledger/6).

correction.text: Cliopatria's 550 Saba shape plus Qataban's Wadi Bayhan land, which came under Saba in the 6th century

keyframe_overrides.why: 'During the 6th century BCE, Qatabān had come under the control of Sabaʾ' and 'regained its independence in the late 5th century BCE'. Saba's ledger/7 (-550) gives Saba Qataban's 52 cells, but this keyframe's shape lacks them, so the snap dropped them and the Wadi Bayhan stayed unowned for -550..-421 (Qataban 52 cells at -551, none at -500).

correction.text: Cliopatria's 450 Saba shape (unchanged, held to 421) plus Qataban's Wadi Bayhan land until Qataban regains its independence in the late 5th century

keyframe_overrides.why: Same as sabaeans_-550: without this entry the -450 snap (a year of the next window, m0500-m0401) drops Qataban's 52 cells again until qataban_-420.
